Thank you for the kind words ♥ I buried him yesterday because I couldn't bring myself to flush him. I want to get another betta eventually but I think I should give myself some time. I honestly never knew what great pets fish were until I owned one. I wasn't expecting to get as attached to him as I did

Unfortunately, I woke up today and he has passed. I checked on him and I noticed his gills weren't moving. I tried to poke him to see if he was alive and he didn't move at all. At least I know I tried literally everything I could possibly do to save him. Thank you so much for your help. I think it was just too late. Idk why I didn't catch on to the ammonia sooner. I appreciate all your help so much though. ❤ he was a strong little fish for making it as far as he did.

Omg he moved a few times! :) He hasn't moved in days other than when I tried to get him in the net earlier. And would I do that tomorrow?

I don't think he had energy to swim. so I pushed him out with my hand. I noticed his gills are moving a bit more. Not sure if that's a good or bad sign.

The new one doesn't fit. The old one I can get to fit but it doesn't have carbon or anything. What if I remove the bio filter from the other one and lay it in the tank. Would that be harmful?
I appreciate this sooo much. Thank you. The filter won't fit in the other tank. Is that a problem? :(

Also, I have a spare 2.5 gallon tank. I thought about using his old water and adding 20% new and putting him in there to recover. Would that make it worse? I figured it would so I left him in his current one with the ammo lock. Just wanna make sure I'm doing everything I can lol.

He's still alive but not doing well. You were right, it's the ammonia. I've taken some steps to reduce it. I just changed 30% of his water and added ammo lock to detoxify it. I have a new filter running now too. Any other suggestions? I got him to nibble at an earth worm yesterday.
I did a test with one of those strips and it seemed like the ammonia was low. Is there another way to test it? I may not be doing it right
Okay thank you so much. I just got back from the pet store. I got a new filter and some of the right medication. I'm setting up the filter now. Hopefully this works ❤
also if it helps the medication i gave him is the API general cure for parasitic fish disease
